changes.description: Add Get Asset node: reads an asset with its status and, optionally, its collections
Add Update Asset node: changes the basic fields of an asset and leaves empty fields unchanged
Add Delete Asset node: moves assets to the Iconik delete queue, 100 per request, where they can be restored
Add Get Metadata node: reads the metadata of an asset or collection for one view as a simple object
Add Set Metadata node: writes metadata values to an asset or collection through a metadata view
Add Search node: searches assets and collections by text and filter, one page or all up to 10,000
Add Create Collection node: creates a collection at root level or in a parent, or returns the existing one
Add Add to Collection node: adds assets or collections to a collection and reports single failures
Add List Collection Contents node: lists the assets and sub-collections of a collection
Add Get Original Download URL node: returns a temporary download URL for an asset's original file
Add Upload File node: uploads a local file to Iconik as a new asset and starts proxy and keyframe generation
